title: Payment Operations Standard — Payment Arrangements Due Dates and Installment Payments
content:
Every plan under Payment Arrangements carries a schedule anchor: one installment number and that installment's due date. All other due dates, and the way payments are applied, follow from the rules below.

## Due dates

The scheduled due date of installment n is the schedule anchor date advanced by n less the schedule anchor installment periods: 7 calendar days per weekly period, 14 calendar days per biweekly period, and one calendar month per monthly period on the same day of the month. An installment before the anchor installment is reached by moving back by the same periods.

| Frequency | Anchor | Installment asked about | Periods from the anchor | Scheduled due date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly | Installment 3 due 15 April | Installment 5 | 2 | 15 June |
| Monthly | Installment 3 due 15 April | Installment 2 | minus 1 | 15 March |
| Biweekly | Installment 3 due 2 April | Installment 5 | 2 | 30 April |
| Weekly | Installment 3 due 2 April | Installment 4 | 1 | 9 April |

(The anchors in this table are hypothetical.)

## Accepting installment payments

Installment payments are accepted only on a plan whose status is active, suspended or broken; a payment on a suspended plan is voluntary and a payment on a broken plan counts toward its cure. The plan's status is read from its record at the time of the payment.

| Plan status | Installment payment accepted | Nature of the payment |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | Scheduled installment |
| Suspended | Yes | Voluntary |
| Broken | Yes | Counts toward the cure |
| Pending authorization, completed, cancelled | No | — |

## When an installment counts as paid

An installment counts as paid when the payments applied to it reach the installment amount less the type's partial-payment tolerance.

Hypothetical figure: with a regular installment of 180.00 and a tolerance of 5.00, payments reaching 175.00 make the installment paid; payments of 174.00 do not.

## Payments above the installment

A payment larger than the installment due is applied by the type's rule for payments above the installment: under "reduce the remaining count" the excess is applied to the last installments so fewer remain; under "advance the next due" it is applied to the next installments in order so their due dates are already met.

## Channels for manual installments

Manual installments may use any channel the account's stage accepts, except that the retail cash payment network is used only where the type allows retail cash network installments.
